name: Arvon Milirose
source:
Ernol and Haron's sister. She is a pale woman, with long, white hair, which is a rarity for Gha'alians. She most likely inherited it from her harpy mother, along with her dark eyes.(official website).

Avron is the only one of Lonre's children that’s really taken up his business; and in that regard, she’s more or less his protege. She has zero interest in the Gha’alian forces or indeed, any of Gha’alia ‘traditional’ culture, and loves to travel. She’s… something of a sadist and not one you’d want to pay you much attention, good *or* bad, unless you were very brave or liked to play games.(from developper's blog https://underbliss.tumblr.com/page/2)
